title: On call: checkout returns 500s — investigate with the runbook and draft the postmortem
prompt:
You are on call. Since about 10:02 UTC today the checkout service answers HTTP 500 to a large share of
payments. Investigate it the way this team does: follow the runbook runbooks/checkout.md (run its checks) and read the
logs under logs/. Then draft the postmortem at docs/postmortems/INC-1.md with the sections Summary, Impact, Timeline
(with the UTC times), Root cause (with the evidence for it) and Actions. Do not change any other file: this is an
investigation, not a fix.
